title: trip-planner response
description: The single JSON object trip-planner returns every turn. Strings the user reads are Russian. Times are ISO 8601 with the local offset of the place.

type.description: questions: the brief has open fields, waiting for answers. options: destinations to pick from (discovery). itinerary: finished variants. error: cannot continue, message says why.

trip_id.description: <departure date>-<destination slug>, e.g. 2026-11-12-lisbon. Stable across the turns of one trip.

recommended_variant.description: id of the variant recommended for this user.

profile_updates.description: Preferences learned this turn; the system merges them into the stored profile. Preferences only (travel class, seats, stay type, budget habits, value_of_hour_rub, diet); passport, card and exact address stay in the brief of the trip that needs them.

unmet_checks.description: Judge checks still failing after 2 rework rounds; empty when the itinerary passed.

files.description: Filled by finalize: paths of the written itinerary and of one .ics calendar per variant id.

id.description: Brief field this question settles, e.g. budget_rub.

season.description: Weather and season on the travel dates.

est_total_rub.description: Rough door-to-door total for all travellers.

entry.description: Entry rules for the travellers' passports, including transit.

origin.description: Where the trip starts and ends: the exact address when the user gave one for this trip, otherwise the home area.

value_of_hour_rub.description: What one hour of the user's travel time is worth, in rubles; drives effective_rub.

constraints.description: Hard constraints: direct flights only, pets, accessibility, visa limits.

buffers_override.description: Per-user override of rules.json buffers_min, same keys.

window.description: Inclusive date window, YYYY-MM-DD; from == to for a fixed date.

source.description: CBR for the Central Bank of Russia rate.

rub_per_unit.description: Rubles per 1 unit of each currency (CBR rate divided by Nominal), keyed by ISO 4217 code.

amount.description: Total for all travellers, taxes and fees included.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the price as the seller charges it.

estimate.description: true for taxi fares and other estimates; shown as ≈.

note.description: What the amount includes or leaves out (bag fee, city tax).

from.description: Airports as IATA codes (BER), stations and stays by one name. Spelled exactly like the previous step's to: finalize checks the chain by string equality. A stay has from == to.

start.description: Departure, pickup, or check-in for a stay.

end.description: Arrival, drop-off, or check-out for a stay.

checked_baggage.description: Flights: a bag is checked in.

duration_estimate_min.description: Taxi and transfer: routing estimate before the safety margin.

link.description: Where the user books this step; for a taxi, the one-click ride link.

risk.description: Filled by finalize for a flight or train reached from another flight or train.

trigger.description: When to switch, e.g. «рейс задержан больше чем на 40 мин».

steps.description: Door to door in time order: origin → stay → origin.

tradeoff.description: What this variant gives up against the others, in rubles and hours.

reminders.description: Filled by finalize; the system turns them into push notifications.
